name: nosy
description: Nosy about your product. Never your data. The nosy product manager that lives inside your coding agent: looks at the backend, git and roadmap first, then rivals; doesn't do code review, makes product decisions.

disable_psst_hook.title: Turn off the opening summary
disable_psst_hook.description: Stops the SessionStart hook from printing a one-line "Psst…" summary from pm/state/lowhanging.json. Commands and the skill are unaffected.

disable_update_check.title: Turn off the update notice
disable_update_check.description: Stops the session-start hook from asking GitHub, once a day, which Nosy version is the newest (one GET of the public file .claude-plugin/plugin.json, nothing sent about you or your repo) and from saying so when yours is older. Commands and the skill are unaffected.

disable_commit_nudge.title: Turn off the after-commit nudge
disable_commit_nudge.description: Stops the PostToolUse hook that, after a commit or merge, says which matrix gap it may close, the next product decision, and the next command. Commands and the skill are unaffected.

disable_never_check.title: Turn off the never-rule check
disable_never_check.description: Stops the PostToolUse hook that, after a git commit or gh pr create, checks what went in against pm/sources.json's never rules and tells the agent when one matches. It never blocks or undoes anything. Commands and the skill are unaffected.

disable_cite_check.title: Turn off the reference check
disable_cite_check.description: Stops the hook that, when the agent finishes an answer or writes a markdown file in a repo with pm/sources.json, checks every file:line, quote, commit and #ref in it (skill/tools/cite-check.mjs) and sends it back to fix the ones that don't hold up. It asks once per answer, so it can't loop. Commands and the skill are unaffected.
